Name: Cheaper Preserves Jar
Author: Aldwwyn
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Mod: Cheaper Preserves Jars[/center][/size]

[/b][size=3][b]Description: [/b]The Cheaper Preserves Jars mod for Stardew Valley aims to balance the crafting of preserves jars by allowing players to adjust the quantity of items needed to make these jars. This mod offers flexibility in the recipe, making the gameplay experience more personalized and adaptable to your preferences.

[/size][b]
[/b][b]Mod Objective: [/b][size=3]With this mod, you can modify the amounts of wood and stone required to create preserves jars. The goal is to make jar crafting more accessible, allowing you to save resources while developing your farm. Customizing the recipe helps tailor it to your playstyle, whether you're a new player or a veteran looking for a fresh approach.[/size]

[b]
Important: [/b][size=3]While the mod allows you to adjust quantities, [/size][b][size=4]I encourage you not to reduce the wood and stone requirements too much[/size][/b][size=3]. Maintaining a balance between resource accessibility and game challenge contributes to a richer and more engaging experience in [/size][b]Stardew Valley[/b][size=3].[/size]

[b]
Installation: [/b][size=3]To install the mod, you will need [/size][b]Content Patcher[/b][size=3]. Simply download the mod and follow the instructions on the page to integrate it into your game.[/size]


[b]Acknowledgments: [/b][size=3]Thank you for trying out the [/size][b]Cheaper Preserves Jars[/b][size=3]! I hope you enjoy a more personalized and fun gameplay experience. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave a comment![/size]

Downloads.Description: Mod updated to version 1.2.0, compatible with game version 1.6.15. Added the option to change the amount of coal required to craft the Preserves Jar.

Manifest.Description: Reduces the amount of items needed to create Preserves Jar by half.
